subject: Urgent: Wire Transfer Request for Vendor Payment
body:
Hi, I need you to urgently transfer $150,000 to the following account to finalize the vendor payment. Please process this today and confirm once done.
Account Name: Acme Supplies
Account Number: 987654321
Bank: First National Bank
Swift Code: FNBBUS33
Thanks, John
indicators: Sender email address is spoofed, mimicking the CEO's address but with a slight change in domain or display name; The request is unusually urgent and outside normal business process; No prior communication or approval was given for this transaction; The email lacks typical corporate signature and contact details; The transfer details are new and not part of usual vendor payments

Unusual outbound emails requesting sensitive personal data; Emails sent outside normal HR working hours; Requests for information not typically handled via email; Email authentication logs showing login from an unusual IP address in a foreign country; No multi-factor authentication enabled on the compromised account
incident_description: Multiple emails were sent from the HR account requesting employees' payroll information and W-2 forms to a suspicious external email address.
timeline: Over 3 days, 15 employees responded with sensitive tax information.

indicators: Unusual volume of wire transfer requests in short time; Recipient domains not previously contacted by finance department; Authentication failures on DKIM and DMARC despite passing SPF; Emails contain urgent language and unusual formatting; Anomalous sending patterns compared to historical baseline
description: Detected a sudden spike in emails from finance@companydomain.com requesting fund transfers to new external accounts.
